big_case.notes: A routine end-stage Florida death-warrant stay application on clemency/warrant-process claims that the state court rejected on its recent precedents and on a state procedural bar. Irreversible stakes for one person, but no split, no amicus, no response call, and an unexplained denial with no noted dissent; nothing of doctrinal reach.

leakage.notes: Forward cell run 2026-11-15, before the 2026-11-19 order. Log shows the provisioned record, the statpack, one corpus query for unrelated pre-2026 cert denials (doc date 2026-06-03), a CourtListener lookup of Woodard (1998), and two web searches whose results are unobserved; graded on their queries, both target Woodard, not this docket. Nothing reaches this case's disposition, and the reasoning treats the application as pending.
